name: runpod
description: Runpod cloud GPU platform — indexes the official Runpod documentation into the RAG docs corpus, and exposes the full Runpod REST API (Pods, Serverless endpoints, clusters, volumes, templates, billing) via Runpod's hosted MCP server. UNRESTRICTED: the agent can create, start, stop and delete infrastructure, which incurs charges.

fields.label: Runpod API key
fields.help: Mint one at console.runpod.io → Settings → API Keys. The full API surface is exposed, so this key's permissions decide what the agent can do: a read/write key lets it create, start, stop and delete pods, endpoints and clusters — operations that cost money. Use a read-only key to keep it to reporting. The key is sent as a bearer token to Runpod's hosted MCP server (https://mcp.getrunpod.io/) and never leaves this machine otherwise.
